property_summary: Only the jojoTeam address may successfully call newEmergencyOracle; calls from other addresses must revert without creating a new EmergencyOracle (i.e., NewEmergencyOracle event not emitted and address unchanged).

property_summary: Calling newEmergencyOracle must not change jojoTeam and will only succeed when this test contract is jojoTeam; otherwise it reverts.

When newEmergencyOracle succeeds, it must emit NewEmergencyOracle with msg.sender equal to jojoTeam and the emitted newOracle must be a non-zero address; if it reverts then jojoTeam remains unchanged.

Calling newEmergencyOracle either reverts or (if it succeeds) does not change jojoTeam and results in a NewEmergencyOracle emission by the contract creating a non-zero newOracle (we observe success implies jojoTeam was the caller and remains unchanged).

Calling newEmergencyOracle either reverts or (if it succeeds) emits an event creating a non-zero EmergencyOracle and does not change jojoTeam; the call can only succeed when msg.sender equals jojoTeam.
